 This Wp Is Filed Under Articles 226 And 227 Of
The Constitution Of India Praying To The Petitioner
Seeks The Issuance Of A Writ Of Mandamus Directing
The Respondent No.6 To Investigate Against Shoaib.
 This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice M.Nagaprasanna
 Oral Order

The petitioner is before this Court seeking the following prayers:
"1.
The petitioner seeks issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondent No.6 to investigate against Shoaib.

2. The petitioner seeks the intervention of this Hon'ble Court to ensure that the police department conducts a thorough investigation into the allegations of exploitation,
fraud, rape, and domestic violence.
NC: 2025:KHC:18686 HC-KAR 3.

The petitioner seeks to direct the respondent No.6 to impound the passport of the Shoaib the respondent No.1.
4.

The petitioner seeks the intervention of the court to direct cyber crime police respondent no.9 to restrain the respondent no.1 from dumping the naked video's/photos of petitioner which the respondent had taken during the relationship into the social media."

2. This Court on 02-06-2025 had passed the following order:
Mrs. Kavi Verma vs Syed Shoaib on 3 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114788771/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "The petition is preferred on the premise that the police are not registering the crime.

The learned High Court Government Pleader would submit that if the petitioner would appear, even today, at 6:00p.m. at K.G. Halli Police Station, the crime would be registered and registration of the crime of the report would be reported to the Court on 03.06.2025.
List this matter on 03.06.2025 at 2.30 p.m."
3.

Learned Additional Government Advocate Sri Rahul Cariappa, on instructions would submit that,
the police have now registered a crime in Crime No.202 of 2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 420, 504 and 506 of the IPC and investigation has commenced since yesterday.
NC: 2025:KHC:18686 HC-KAR 4.
In that light, petition stands disposed.
However, liberty is reserved to the petitioner to knock at the doors of this Court in the event of need.

Sd/-
(M.NAGAPRASANNA) JUDGE BKP
